summary:
**FLIGHT WINGS — Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer**

FLIGHT WINGS is an interactive educational experience that introduces young learners to astronaut training and the challenges of space exploration. Players take on the role of junior astronauts and complete simulated missions on the Moon and Mars, solving problems involving spacecraft systems, space weather, equipment diagnostics, and mission survival.

Through interactive scenarios, decision-making, and mission-based gameplay, the project transforms complex scientific concepts into an engaging and accessible learning experience. It aims to encourage curiosity about space, develop problem-solving skills, and introduce younger audiences to real-world challenges faced by astronauts.

The experience connects its educational content to NASA-related scientific information, helping players understand the science behind human exploration beyond Earth.
details:
FLIGHT WINGS is an interactive educational astronaut mission trainer designed to introduce young learners to the challenges of space exploration. Players take on the role of junior astronauts and complete simulated missions inspired by lunar and Martian exploration. Through interactive scenarios, mini-games, mission briefings, and problem-solving challenges, players learn about spacecraft systems, equipment diagnostics, space weather, and the difficulties of operating in unfamiliar environments.

The project transforms complex space science concepts into an engaging, hands-on learning experience rather than relying solely on traditional reading materials. Its goal is to encourage curiosity about space, develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills, and make space exploration more accessible to younger audiences.

Our approach combines educational content with interactive gameplay, using mission-based progression to make learning enjoyable and memorable. The project was developed using web technologies, including JavaScript, JSX, React, HTML, and CSS, with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude and Google AI Studio. We considered accessibility, age-appropriate explanations, educational accuracy, usability, and engagement when designing the experience.
